notes:
MusicDev 0.8.6 fixes the **Update and restart** button and adds **Check for updates** to Studio. Both Studio and Library show when a newer version is available.

**Upgrading from 0.8.4 or 0.8.5?** Those versions can find a release but reject the install request. Download and run **MusicDev-Setup-x64.exe** below once. Setup keeps your Library and Studio data. Future releases can be installed from within MusicDev.

**Bruger du 0.8.4 eller 0.8.5?** Hent og kør **MusicDev-Setup-x64.exe** herunder én gang. Dit bibliotek og dine sangprojekter bevares. Fremover kan du vælge **Søg efter opdateringer** i Studio eller under **Bibliotek → Indstillinger**.
